verdict.rationale: pnpm documents verification of ECDSA registry signatures for installed packages against each registry's published keys at /-/npm/v1/keys (pnpm-docs-11, -26, -30). The `--update-checksums` flag is described as a narrow opt-in for when a registry rewrites tarballs, which implies install-time checksum checks are enforced by default (pnpm-docs-35). Frozen-lockfile mode in CI (pnpm-docs-13, -34) supports that integrity enforcement. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party description of default install-time integrity/checksum checking, evidence that signature verification runs automatically before packages execute rather than as a separate `pnpm audit` step, any provenance/attestation verification, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
